chunks.title: Cadila Health Care Ltd. v. Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd., (2001) 5 SCC 73
chunks.content:
### Cadila Health Care Ltd. v. Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd., (2001) 5 SCC 73
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India
**Core Holding:** Established the test for deceptive similarity in pharmaceutical products: higher standard of care applies to avoid confusion where medicinal products with similar phonetic names could cause harm.

chunks.title: Eastern Book Company v. D.B. Modak, (2008) 1 SCC 1
chunks.content:
### Eastern Book Company v. D.B. Modak, (2008) 1 SCC 1
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India
**Core Holding:** Adopted the "modicum of creativity" standard for copyright originality in legal reports and headnotes, rejecting the pure "sweat of the brow" doctrine.

chunks.title: Interim Injunctions & Anton Piller Orders
chunks.content:
### Interim Injunctions & Anton Piller Orders
1. **Anton Piller (Search & Seizure):** Ex-parte local commissioner appointment to seize infringing stocks without prior notice to prevent destruction of evidence.
2. **Deceptive Similarity Comparison:** Side-by-side microscopic comparison is impermissible; test is imperfect recollection of average consumer.

chunks.title: Trade Marks Act, 1999
chunks.content:
### Trade Marks Act, 1999
- **Section 29:** Infringement of registered trademarks by identical or deceptively similar marks used in the course of trade causing public confusion.
- **Section 27(2):** Common law action for passing off to protect goodwill and business reputation against misrepresentation.

chunks.title: Copyright Act, 1957
chunks.content:
### Copyright Act, 1957
- **Section 14 & 51:** Exclusive rights in literary, dramatic, musical, artistic works and cinematograph films; infringement by unauthorized reproduction, performance, or broadcast.
- **Section 52:** Fair dealing exceptions for private study, research, criticism, review, and reporting of current events.
